name: 5. Replan after a confirmed cue-ball error

expected.why: Natural shots on the 1 (top side pocket) leave the cue ball above the 2, where the 2 goes in the bottom-right corner. If the cue ball instead really stops at (55, 12), below and left of the 2, the bottom-right corner is an 83 degree cut and the top-right corner a 13 degree cut, so the plan for the 2 must switch to the top-right corner (pocket 5).

found: hand-made; probe.js: plain shots on the 1 mostly end at (85-98, 41-49); potGeom from (55,12): pocket 2 cut 83, pocket 5 cut 13
